# RaidzOn

> RaidzOn (raidzon.com) is a free kabaddi scoring and tournament app, like CricHeroes for kabaddi. Scorers record matches raid by raid on a phone, even offline at the court; fans follow live kabaddi scores through a shared link; organizers run tournaments with fixtures, groups and points tables; players get raid and tackle stats on their profile.

RaidzOn is a web app (installable PWA) for Android, iPhone and desktop browsers. No download from an app store is needed.

## Features

- Live kabaddi scoring: raid points, tackle points, bonus points, super raids, super tackles, all outs, do-or-die raids, substitutions, revivals, raid and half timers, undo.
- Offline first: every raid is saved on the phone and syncs when the connection returns.
- Live score sharing: a /watch link shows the score, current raider and match events in real time; a /scorecard link shows a compact shareable scorecard.
- Tournaments: host a tournament, register teams and squads, generate fixtures (league, groups, knockouts), automatic points table / standings, team join requests.
- Player stats: player profiles with raid points, tackle points and leaderboards (top raiders, top defenders).
- Scoring without an account; sign in with a phone number (OTP) to share live, keep stats or run a tournament.

## Key URLs

- [Home](https://raidzon.com/): start scoring, browse tournaments, your matches
- [Help & FAQ](https://raidzon.com/help): how scoring, live sharing and tournaments work
- [Privacy policy](https://raidzon.com/privacy)
- Tournament: https://raidzon.com/tournaments/{tournamentId} (overview, points table, fixtures and results, bracket, top raiders and defenders, teams)
- Player: https://raidzon.com/players/{playerId} (career raid and tackle points, tournaments played)
- Live match: https://raidzon.com/watch/{matchId}
- Shared scorecard: https://raidzon.com/scorecard/{shareId}
- [Sitemap](https://raidzon.com/sitemap.xml): every public tournament, player, match and scorecard page
